description: This file defines classes for server orchestration in an Orleans distributed system, including configuration and runtime management of silos within a test environment.

classes.name: CommonParameters
classes.description: Holds configuration parameters for the server, such as service and cluster IDs, ports, URIs, and activation repartitioning toggle.

classes.name: ServerRunner`1
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of an Orleans silo server, including configuration, startup, message processing, and shutdown.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the server lifecycle including channel message handling and Orleans host management.

methods.name: ConfigureOrleans
methods.description: Configures an Orleans silo builder with provided parameters and options.
